framework: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality)
note: Control IDs and short titles follow the named framework. The summaries and evidence hints are the project author's own paraphrases for retrieval and assessment, not the text of the framework. Consult the official publication for authoritative wording. The 'impact' weight (1-5) is a generic default for the risk scorer; tune it for your organisation. Processing Integrity and Privacy criteria are not included.

controls.title: Integrity and ethical values
controls.summary: The organization sets and demonstrates standards of conduct, and personnel acknowledge them.
controls.evidence_hint: Code of conduct, signed acknowledgements, ethics reporting channel

controls.title: Board oversight
controls.summary: A board or equivalent body, independent of management, oversees how internal control is designed and operated.
controls.evidence_hint: Board charter, minutes showing security and risk oversight

controls.title: Structure, authority and responsibility
controls.summary: Management sets up structures, reporting lines and responsibilities needed to meet objectives.
controls.evidence_hint: Org chart, role descriptions, RACI matrix

controls.title: Commitment to competence
controls.summary: The organization attracts, develops and retains people with the skills its objectives need.
controls.evidence_hint: Hiring standards, training plans, performance reviews

controls.title: Accountability
controls.summary: People are held accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
controls.evidence_hint: Performance goals tied to control duties, disciplinary procedure

controls.title: Quality information
controls.summary: Relevant, reliable information is obtained or produced to support internal control.
controls.evidence_hint: Log and data inventories, reports used to monitor controls

controls.title: Internal communication
controls.summary: Information needed for control, including individual responsibilities, is communicated inside the organization.
controls.evidence_hint: Policy distribution records, intranet pages, awareness communications

controls.title: External communication
controls.summary: Matters affecting control are communicated to customers, vendors and other outside parties.
controls.evidence_hint: Customer-facing security documents, contract terms, incident notification commitments

controls.title: Clear objectives
controls.summary: Objectives are specified clearly enough to allow risks to be identified and assessed.
controls.evidence_hint: Documented business and security objectives

controls.title: Risk identification and analysis
controls.summary: Risks to meeting objectives are identified and analysed as the basis for deciding how to manage them.
controls.evidence_hint: Risk assessment, risk register, risk methodology

controls.title: Fraud risk
controls.summary: The potential for fraud is considered when assessing risks.
controls.evidence_hint: Fraud risk assessment, anti-fraud controls

controls.title: Significant change
controls.summary: Changes that could affect the system of internal control are identified and assessed.
controls.evidence_hint: Change impact assessments, risk assessment refresh records

controls.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
controls.summary: Ongoing or periodic evaluations confirm that controls are in place and working.
controls.evidence_hint: Internal audit plan, control testing results, monitoring dashboards

controls.title: Deficiency evaluation and reporting
controls.summary: Control deficiencies are evaluated and reported to responsible parties in time to act.
controls.evidence_hint: Issue log, corrective action tracking, management reports

controls.title: Selecting and developing controls
controls.summary: Control activities that reduce risks to acceptable levels are selected and developed.
controls.evidence_hint: Control matrix mapped to risks

controls.title: Technology general controls
controls.summary: General control activities over technology are selected and developed.
controls.evidence_hint: IT general controls documentation, baseline standards

controls.title: Policies and procedures
controls.summary: Controls are put in place through policies that set expectations and procedures that carry them out.
controls.evidence_hint: Approved policy set, procedures, review records

controls.title: Logical access security
controls.summary: Logical access security software, infrastructure and architecture protect information assets.
controls.evidence_hint: Access control policy, SSO and MFA configuration, encryption standards

controls.title: User registration and authorization
controls.summary: New users are registered and authorized before credentials are issued, and removed when access is no longer needed.
controls.evidence_hint: Access request tickets, onboarding and offboarding records

controls.title: Role-based access and least privilege
controls.summary: Access is granted, changed and removed by role and least privilege, and reviewed periodically.
controls.evidence_hint: Role matrix, periodic access reviews

controls.title: Physical access
controls.summary: Physical access to facilities and protected assets is limited to authorized people.
controls.evidence_hint: Badge logs, visitor logs, data centre access lists

controls.title: Asset disposal
controls.summary: Protections are removed from assets that are no longer needed, and data on them is securely destroyed.
controls.evidence_hint: Media sanitization procedure, destruction certificates

controls.title: Threats from outside the system
controls.summary: Controls protect the system against threats that originate outside its boundaries.
controls.evidence_hint: Firewall rules, web application firewall, network diagrams, penetration test

controls.title: Restricting data movement
controls.summary: Moving, sending and removing information is limited to authorized people and protected in transit.
controls.evidence_hint: Encryption in transit, data loss prevention, removable media rules

controls.title: Malicious software
controls.summary: Controls prevent or detect unauthorized or malicious software.
controls.evidence_hint: Endpoint protection deployment, patch status, alerts

controls.title: Vulnerability and configuration monitoring
controls.summary: Detection and monitoring procedures identify configuration changes and newly found vulnerabilities.
controls.evidence_hint: Vulnerability scans, configuration monitoring, patch SLAs

controls.title: Anomaly monitoring
controls.summary: System components are monitored for anomalies that point to malicious acts, disasters or errors.
controls.evidence_hint: SIEM or alerting configuration, monitoring runbooks

controls.title: Security event evaluation
controls.summary: Security events are evaluated to decide whether they are incidents.
controls.evidence_hint: Triage criteria, event logs, severity matrix

controls.title: Incident response
controls.summary: Incidents are contained, fixed and communicated under a defined response program.
controls.evidence_hint: Incident response plan, incident tickets, post-incident reviews

controls.title: Incident recovery
controls.summary: Activities to recover from incidents are identified, developed and carried out.
controls.evidence_hint: Recovery procedures, lessons learned, recovery test records

controls.title: Change management
controls.summary: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorized, designed, tested, approved and implemented under control.
controls.evidence_hint: Change policy, tickets showing approval and test evidence

controls.title: Business disruption risk
controls.summary: Risk reduction covers business disruptions, including continuity planning and insurance.
controls.evidence_hint: Business continuity plan, disaster recovery plan, insurance cover

controls.title: Vendor and partner risk
controls.summary: Risks from vendors and business partners are assessed and managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Vendor register, due diligence, contracts, periodic reviews

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.summary: Processing capacity and its use are monitored and managed to meet availability commitments.
controls.evidence_hint: Capacity reports, alert thresholds

controls.title: Environmental protection, backup and recovery
controls.summary: Environmental protections, backup processes and recovery infrastructure are designed and operated.
controls.evidence_hint: Backup logs, redundancy design, environmental controls

controls.title: Recovery testing
controls.summary: Recovery plan procedures are tested to support availability commitments.
controls.evidence_hint: Disaster recovery test reports, restore tests

controls.title: Identifying confidential information
controls.summary: Confidential information is identified and maintained to meet confidentiality commitments.
controls.evidence_hint: Classification scheme, data inventory

controls.title: Disposing of confidential information
controls.summary: Confidential information is disposed of in line with confidentiality commitments.
controls.evidence_hint: Retention schedule, deletion records, destruction certificates
